events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

events.text:
**Migration paused: 120 of 400 records migrated.**

The new CRM incorrectly added `+1` to phone numbers for 31 overseas customers. Sales has started using the CRM; 14 users opened records, but it’s unknown whether they saw affected records. Further batches may have the same issue.

Please provide a trusted source for the correct numbers and a way to prevent the issue in remaining batches. Recommend warning sales not to rely on migrated phone numbers until validated.
